title: Mixed Event — We Escape to Survive

meta.Outline: With Mafuyu's contact with the group restricted, the rest of N25 think what they can do for her. Hoping to give her some peace of mind, Mizuki comes up with a plan...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I guess Yuki isn't coming today either...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <However, she's been sending us her lyrics, and we've been able to meet her at the diner on occasion...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But it's been two weeks now since she last worked with us on Nightcord...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Do you think her mom's still spying on her...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's already been that long since then...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu's mom and I parted ways once we exited the hotel...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No room in her life for music. How can she say that...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: She's just completely ignoring how Mafuyu actually feels...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I got a bad feeling when I overheard Mafuyu speak with her on voice chat that one time...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But Kanade's story confirmed my suspicions. Mafuyu's mom... She...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She doesn't care at all how Mafuyu feels...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Are you sure you don't want to tell Mafuyu about this...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Once she knows how her mom really thinks, she might...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I've already gone over that in my head.
Unfortunately...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Even if we were to tell Mafuyu, I'm not sure she'd be able to process this information... At least, not right now...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: She's doing everything she can to destroy who you really are. How can you even think about showing her any mercy?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She cares about me. She's not trying to...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, come on. Open your eyes.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You know exactly what she's trying to do. But you just keep—

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I have a feeling that Mafuyu continues to believe that her mother genuinely cares about her, and would never do anything to cause her pain...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: She's still clinging to that somehow...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And I think she's doing it subconsciously...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, even if we did tell her what her mother said, there's a high likelihood that she wouldn't immediately accept it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: If anything, it could just make things worse and cause her more pain...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, what are we supposed to do...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I understand how you feel, but we simply don't have a solution right now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I'm confident that there is a way out there to help her.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, let's try to figure that out.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sitting back and watching while Mafuyu suffers just doesn't seem right.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's brainstorm and see what we can do!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (We spent a lot of time thinking after that, but...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, wanna meet in SEKAI for a bit...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <For, you know...? A little change of scenery! Seriously, my shoulders are starting to ache after sitting in this chair for so long...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Also, I wanna tell Miku and the others about Yuki's current situation!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, I agree with you on that...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Then, let's take a quick break in SEKAI.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Meet you there in five! And bring snacks!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Does this mean your new song's finished...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, we just came to take a break.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is Mafuyu still not able to come...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No...
She can't do much in the evening now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But you're trying to think of a way to help her, no?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
So, for example...
We've been trying to find ways to meet her more often when she's out and stuff. That way she can feel a little more at ease.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also, we've been trying to have meetings at a cafe or a diner when she's coming home from school.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And... You've been trying to compose more songs faster, right, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I have. Because I firmly believe that Mafuyu needs the time we use to make songs as N25.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We haven't been able to solve the core issue.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: She hasn't been able to work every day, but she always seems to feel relieved whenever she gets to see us...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But we don't have the power to immediately improve her current situation.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ideally, we'd be able to convince Mafuyu's mom to accept what we're doing...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But that sounds impossible based on what you told us, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Then, is there anything we can do right now...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I suspect that you've already considered it as an option.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In the end, you'll need to make Mafuyu break herself out of this situation.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I have a feeling that Mafuyu will be able to muster up the courage to fight back once she understands what her mom is doing to her. So, I would tell Mafuyu that straight away...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, Luka, you're right. We've already considered that...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Because... We'd be asking far too much of Mafuyu... I doubt she'd immediately understand...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Right.
Mafuyu probably wouldn't be able to process what her mother has said.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Especially since the person who she believes has her best interests in mind simply doesn't care about her happiness.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Unfortunately, if you wish to get her out of this situation, then she will need to deal with the painful truth...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I want to avoid that as much as possible.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Of course, you all have every right to wish for that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There may come a time when you won't be left with any other choice.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Up until now, we've been able to help Mafuyu feel a little better... But we haven't been able to actually change anything.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (There probably are better ideas out there, but we're struggling to come up with them...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Which sort of means that we'll need to keep Luka's solution in mind moving forward.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (If we don't act soon, Mafuyu's mom is probably gonna really start trying to keep us away from her daughter...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Which is only going to put Mafuyu in an even worse place...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(At the same time, Kanade's right...
I doubt Mafuyu's in a state right now where she can properly process the truth.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Alright, I'm gonna get back to work...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We couldn't come up with any good ideas...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line: <Sorry for not responding sooner, but I won't be able to do anything today. I'll try working on my lyrics tomorrow if I have time.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She's probably sending us this while her mom's not watching...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Even at home, she's a prisoner...
What in the world does that feel like?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Home was a place of refuge for me...
I could just be myself here.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (In or outside of home, Mafuyu's not allowed to be herself. On top of that, her time with us—the one place she could escape—has been taken away from her...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (If she has to keep enduring this...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Seriously, isn't there anything we can do...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(It doesn't have to be big.
Just some time that allows Mafuyu to be herself.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Isn't there a way to get her family to understand...? Like the way mine did for me...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Mom, Dad and Sis all took the time to understand when I really needed a place to run.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Because they did, I could just be myself at home.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Yeah...
What if we could work with her for little bits at a time...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(But her mom's watching her like a hawk...
The only time we could work together would be...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<K! Enanan!
Sorry, I know you're both working, but can we chat for a second?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I just came up with a really good idea!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <We're gonna work on Nightcord while Mafuyu's at school during her lunch break...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Based on what we know, Mafuyu's only directly being watched at night when she's at home, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, why not just work during the day when she's at school?!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I see...
That may actually give Mafuyu time to work...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Oh, hang on...
I remember her telling me how busy she is when she's at school. She always seems to have her hands full with student council stuff.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Right...
There's no guarantee that she'd have time to get any work done...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But it might be worth asking her...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Since she may actually start feeling better if we get to work together a little more.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I agree...
I like this idea.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<...!
Thanks, you two!
Then, I'll ask her right away!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's only gonna give her some temporary relief...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But it's also important for her to have that sort of time. So...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Is she hiding under her covers with her phone or something? I hope her mom doesn't find out...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<That means we need to respond quick.
Let's see what she said...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line: <I don't know if that's going to work...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line: <Various people are always asking for my help during the day.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line: <But thank you for making this suggestion.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(There's gotta be a way...
There must be a place where Mafuyu can work in private...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What if you said you want to use your school's study room to work on your cram school assignments and stuff?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Can't you log into Nightcord on your phone and act like you're doing your homework?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<At the study room?
Won't the other students find out?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Mafuyu, you listen to us chatting while responding through text.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Oh, I see...
That way, no one else would know...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line: <But it could be worth a try.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Let's just try it once to see!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line:
<Then, I'll talk to you all tomorrow.
We can talk again during lunch.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Thank goodness... We might actually be able to work together...!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah!
I don't know if it's gonna go well, but it feels like we've managed to clear our first hurdle!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I agree...
Thank you for suggesting this.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, I need to set my alarm to make sure I don't oversleep tomorrow...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Right! You should as well, Enanan!
Otherwise, you'll definitely sleep through it!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<No, I won't!
She said around lunch, so I should be fine.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hehe.
Then, talk to you both tomorrow!>

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Ugh! That pop quiz! It had to be today, huh?!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Yeah, my stomach sank... I really don't wanna see what I got...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I need to head over to the study room and...)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Asahina, do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh...
H-How can I help you?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: It's about the guidebook for the school trip that's coming up. Do you have some time to discuss it...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: There's something I need to do right now. Would you mind if we discussed this after school?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Oh, of course.
Don't mind me. I was just hoping to hear what you thought was all.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you. If you'll excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (There's so few people here during lunch...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, there she is!
Yuki, can you hear us?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I know not being able to talk is gonna be tough, Yuki, but let's try to get as much done as we can!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<She'll be fine.
I mean, she doesn't talk much to begin with.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line: <Conversely, Enanan, you don't know when to stop.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Hey, what's that supposed to mean?!
We need to communicate if we want to produce good content, right?!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <The lyrics for the bridge could use a little more work. Yuki, this part about “pulling your hand away”... I'd like you to use stronger language here.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line: <Okay, I'll try thinking of something for that.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Oh, Amia!
I recolored that thing I showed you before. Do you have a minute to look at it?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line: <I couldn't even tell what fixes you made last time.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, Yuki, that reminds me. The lyrics for the chorus are all set to go, right? It's this song's big moment, so I wanna do something that gives it impact.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line: <That's fine. That section won't be changed any further.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Okay!
Then, I'll start looking for some good fonts for it♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I can't hear her voice. I can only see what she's writing...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But she seems to be enjoying this...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Okay...
I really like these lyrics. They're exactly what I had in mind.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Hehe. We're getting so much done!
Alright, let's keep this up and...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line: <Sorry, I need to head back soon. Lunch is almost over.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I'm really glad we got to do this.
I hope you can join us again sometime.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Actually communicating with one another definitely does make things go smoother.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line:
<I'd also like to do this again.
I'll try to make room in my schedule.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line:
<Thank you.
Anyway, I'll see you all tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Is it just me, or did Yuki seem kinda happy...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, she must've enjoyed getting to work as a group.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's only for a short time, but I think we have a way to give Mafuyu a safe place to work.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I hope this helps her feel a little better moving forward.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Hey, what's that supposed to mean?!
We need to communicate if we want to produce good content, right?!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Welcome home, Mafuyu.
How was school today?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
What happened today...?
Oh, we played softball during P.E.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, I see.
That must've been a nice stress reducer.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It was. Getting my body loose really helped me focus during my afternoon classes...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
I'm sure you're very hungry.
We'll be having dinner earlier than usual, so why don't you get changed?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, then I'll go upstairs and...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I put it out with the garbage today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I fully understand that you don't wish to give up music...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: However, won't your mind wander if it stayed in the house? Especially now since you really need to be focusing on your studies.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Also, you said that you'd stop.
Which is why I thought now was a good time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
T-That's fine...
I... I don't need it right now anyway...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
See?
I'm glad you understand, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, there's also something I need to apologize to you about...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Remember how I've been borrowing your computer to look up some things?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I took the liberty of using it again today but accidentally spilled my drink on it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: It lost power after that, so I decided to send it out for repairs.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Again, I'm very sorry. I hope you didn't have any of your homework saved to it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: If you did, I can always ask your teachers to...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Um, it's nothing...
My homework shouldn't be an issue...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They keep saying that I'm gonna have to repeat a year, but I honestly couldn't care less about that right now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, it's almost noon.
I should log onto Nightcord and...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Heya!
We're live today from the rooftop of Kamiyama High!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yup. They keep bugging me about my attendance. Because of that, I can't really work today, but I do wanna chat and stuff♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Still hasn't logged on.
But I'm guessing she will soon if we give her a minute.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Also, if we keep meeting like this, we're gonna have to change our name from “Nightcord at 25:00” to “Nightcord at 12:30”...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hey, Yuki!
Wait, you're on voice chat today...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<Yes...
I found a place where not many other people are around...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (If we don't act soon, Mafuyu's mom is probably gonna really start trying to keep us away from her daughter...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Which is only going to put Mafuyu in an even worse place...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <At the moment, I only have my phone... But I can still work.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <At the same time, I can't tell what's going to happen moving forward...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<So...
If you lose contact with me suddenly... I'm sorry in advance.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<...!
You shouldn't be the one who's apologizing...!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<But if something like that does happen...
Let's meet up at our usual diner!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <We should pick a date now so that we'll still be able to see each other just in case.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You're really just gonna let her have her way...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <She threw away something that meant a lot to you, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That's like her saying your real thoughts and feelings belong in the trash! Am I wrong...?!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Okay, fine... Let's say you're right...
Even so, now's not the time for any of that...!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<You need to show her that you're mad...
Because if you don't, she's gonna smash you to pieces!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I don't know why, but I've always been afraid...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I need to head back. I have class soon...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <We'll be waiting for you right here tomorrow!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I knew that Mafuyu wouldn't take it well... But I just blurted out what was on my mind...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'm sure Mafuyu understands that you're very worried about her, Ena...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <We shouldn't let things take their course...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I agree with Mizuki in terms of setting up ways to meet with Mafuyu in person.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But if we do begin losing contact with her, she's going to have an incredibly tough time getting anything done for N25...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <If she loses access to both her computer and phone... That means she'll also lose access to SEKAI...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <She just keeps pushing Mafuyu further and further into a corner by taking everything that means anything to her daughter...!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (First, her synthesizer gets tossed and now her computer's gone. The walls are really starting to close in on Mafuyu...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (As much as we want to help her...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (What can we actually do about all this...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (We discussed what's going on after that for hours, but we still couldn't come up with anything good...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(What do we do...?
Time just keeps on slipping.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (There's even a chance that Mafuyu's gonna get her phone taken away when she gets home today...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: We thought you went home already since you sorta disappeared during lunch!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: You know, if Mizuki doesn't like people pointing it out, why not just dress normally for school?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: I know, right? Of course people are going to say things when you stand out like that.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: That's just the way Mizuki is, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Totally. Some people just don't know how to fit in.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I was just heading home...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Oh, okay!
We were just thinking about checking out this new shop that opened up by the station. Wanna come?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: They apparently have all your favorite cosmetic brands there, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Now's not really the time for this...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I hate to do this, but I need to just come up with an excuse and...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: We were also just talking about how we haven't spoken much with you recently and that it'd be fun to hang out together.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Things are definitely more fun when you're around, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: And spending time hanging out after school like this might make you want to come to school more, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(They weren't being mean that time.
They probably just didn't know...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (They don't understand how hard it is sometimes to have to put on a face and not be yourself in order to “get along”...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Is something wrong? Are you feeling okay?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But if I told them now, they might understand...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'm really sorry...
But there's something I need to take care of today.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Okay...
That's too bad, but we get it. Life happens.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: But we should totally go check it out together next time! We'll send pics of what we bought later!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay, thanks...
See ya and have fun!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Home sweet home...
The place where I can just relax and be myself...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But Mafuyu can't even do that at her own house...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(At school or at home...
It's like she's suffering no matter where she is...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (In a way, that makes Mafuyu an amazingly strong girl...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I mean, whenever I was faced with a tough situation...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'm really sorry...
But there's something I need to take care of today.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Come to think of it...
I've been doing that for as long as I can remember.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I ran from everything that I thought would cause me pain. I still want to even though I've found some friends that I really don't want to lose...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Which begs the question...
Am I capable of providing a place for someone to run?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Unlike Kanade and Ena, I've never really been able to deal with any of my own problems...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (So, what right do I have to try and help someone else...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Message
rows.Line: <Just as an update, the new demo's on schedule to be completed tomorrow. I'd like for us to listen to it together the day after tomorrow in SEKAI if Yuki's available to join us.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
My mind's not in a good place today...
I just keep latching onto the negatives.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I need... To chill out a bit...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I thought I'd be able to relax a little if I came here...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(But it's not working...
My brain just won't cool it.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Is everything okay...?
You don't look very happy...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
Don't worry. I was just thinking about something...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You say you were just thinking about something, but your eyes tell a different story.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Were you two watching me this whole time? You could've said hi or something...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
S-Sorry...
Luka said we were just going to take a quick peek...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're no fun, Len. Spilling the beans like that...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Anyway, Mizuki, what's on your mind?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I want to help Mafuyu, but haven't been able to come up with any good ideas...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: My guess is that you're not just thinking about Mafuyu, but also yourself.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No reason in particular. Just my gut feeling.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: To be fair, you're pretty much spot on...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: My mind keeps asking me, “Do you, of all people, think you can help Mafuyu?”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Finding a solution to all of Mafuyu's problems isn't going to be easy, so I thought I could at least provide a place for her to run...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: A place for her to run?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. I went through a really tough period way back when, but I was able to get through it because I had a place where I could run and feel safe...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, I thought if Mafuyu also had a place where she could run...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But reminiscing about my past led me to ask myself...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What right do I have trying to help her...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Kanade's prepared to keep composing songs for Mafuyu until she saves her...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ena said she'd wait for as long as she needs to...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Because all I ever did was run away.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I can't deal with my own problems, and I really don't know how to talk to my friends about stuff that really matters... Even though I really don't want to lose them...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
L-Luka...
You don't have to say it like that...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Isn't there something you can do because you're the way you are?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You say that you're not capable of helping her...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But I believe there's something you can do specifically because you ran from everything until now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You say that, but I don't know...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Just look at things from a slightly different perspective.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Right now, whether she likes it or not, Mafuyu has to face her biggest problems all at once...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And you have a first-hand understanding of just how painful this process is going to be, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: When you felt you were about to break, what did you do?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: When I was about to break...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (When it felt like the real me was gonna disappear forever... That was unbelievably painful...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (At school, even when I was with my classmates, no one understood... I was all alone...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Which is why I wanted to get away from there.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Lucky for me, Mom, Dad and Sis showed genuine concern for my well-being...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(I ended up okay because...
I ran and ran and kept running.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (As I made music videos with them, I gradually became more comfortable with expressing how I really feel...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I felt that I could just be myself.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It was a small glimmer, but I found the light at the end...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I want to tell her that it's okay to run...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Or shout, “Run!”
“It's okay to run away from this place!”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And that there's a safe place where you can run to...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hm? All I did was suggest that you look at things from a slightly different perspective.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I don't know if this is actually gonna help Mafuyu at all...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Lately, my head...
Has been feeling so heavy. I'm struggling to fall asleep...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (The others are probably working right now...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Since I can't sleep, I can work on my lyrics on my phone...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Oh, I left it on my desk...
I need to go get it...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(It's too dark. I can't see...
Where's my phone...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <She threw away something that meant a lot to you, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That's like her saying your real thoughts and feelings belong in the trash! Am I wrong...?!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<You need to show her that you're mad...
Because if you don't, she's gonna smash you to pieces!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Message
rows.Line:
<Sorry, I know it's late.
But I wanna talk to you about something.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Message
rows.Line:
<Can you meet with me sometime soon?
I'm hoping that we can talk in person.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But I have club activities when I don't have cram school. And on the days when I do have to go to cram school...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Message
rows.Line: <We can meet whenever you're free by the way! Still, I do sorta want to see you sooner rather than later...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Message
rows.Line: <There's something I need to tell you.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Uh oh... What if her phone got taken away...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Thanks, Yuki!
Then, I'll meet you out in front of the station!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks for agreeing to meet with me today! So, how much time do you have to spare...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Until cram school ends, so I'd say until nine...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, until cram school ends...?
Does that mean you're skipping?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Are you sure about that?
What if your mom finds out...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's okay. They don't call home or anything whenever I'm not there...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I randomly ran into my dad the other day...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So, I'm a little worried that he might find out...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then, let's move somewhere else before we talk.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No problem!
There's actually somewhere I've been planning to check out!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
SpoJoy Park!
Remember? It's where Kanade and Ena went that other time! I've been wanting to go ever since!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, Mafuyu, what do you wanna do first?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
What do I want to do...?
I thought we were going to talk today...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, but you've been studying nonstop lately. It's important to take breaks from time to time, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Plus, Kanade and the others said they had a lot of fun! I'm sure we'll feel refreshed after we move our bodies around a little!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, Mafuyu, do you know how to rollerblade?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I roller skated some when I was little...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Great!
Then, we can try it together!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I am...?
Rolling forward doesn't seem all that difficult...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hahaha!
Kanade would probably feel awful if you told her that!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, since you seem fine, let's have a race! The last one to that side has to buy the winner a drink!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What?! No, wait!
That means you think you're gonna win, right?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But I'm no slouch!
So, ready... Go!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa, nice! That's three panels back to back! Why are you so good at this...?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It may be because we played softball during P.E. the other day...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You can have the drink I won since you won during our race...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, are you sure?
I mean, I feel pretty bad about jumping the gun back there...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'd rather you have it since it'll actually taste good to you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Anyway, about what you wanted to talk to me...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But are you sure you don't wanna keep doing more stuff?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
...?
I thought you asked to meet with me because...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That can wait!
Just bear with me for a bit longer!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, let's head to the mall!!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whew! That was so much fun!
And I got in some good shopping♪

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Did you really need to take that long to pick out a single outfit...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Absolutely!
I worked hard for this money, so what I buy's gotta be the cutest thing in the world!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Because I've regretted not getting certain clothes and stuff in another color before, you know...?! So much so that I wanna go back in time and stop myself from buying those things!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, do you feel a little better...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I ask because you seem more relaxed now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Actually, I might be feeling a little better...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whenever it feels like the walls are closing in on you, taking your mind off things by doing something else can help, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: In those situations, I always ran towards the things that felt safe and allowed me to relax.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's why I felt that you also needed something or somewhere you could run to, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Is this what you wanted to...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Sorry...
I thought it'd be best to just do it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's a little different from what you're going through, but the truth is, I also went through a period where I wasn't really allowed to be myself...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: A lot of things happened while I was in junior high that led to me becoming the subject of everyone's ridicule. I constantly got all these weird looks...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: As rough as that was, watching anime and making videos helped me get through it...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know. It didn't actually solve anything.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I went about it pretty aimlessly, and going to school eventually became too much for me. Even the one person I could talk to ended up graduating...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
So, I ran from school.
I stopped going.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
At home, I felt safe...
But I still knew deep down that I was running from my problems, which weighed on me a lot...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm standing here today because I gave myself that time...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Because you gave yourself that time...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I believe that taking on whatever life throws at you takes a lot of energy.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: At the same time, if you can't get away from your problems, they'll just sap away all of your energy until there's nothing left.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You know what I mean, right?
After suffering through so much pain for so long, you just sorta lose the will to go on...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Which is why I believe in order for that not to happen... And to survive...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's necessary to have a place where you can run to whenever you need it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Obviously, I'm not saying running is the best option since it doesn't actually help solve anything. And it only provides short-term relief...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I believe that it's okay to run when you're faced with an unbearable amount of pain and suffering that's going to take your life force away.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: When you think you've reached your limit, I say run. Get out while you can.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: For your own sake, Mafuyu. You. No one else.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm sure it's hard to get your head around right now since you might not be ready yet.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I just want you to keep that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: When you find yourself backed into a corner, you still have the option to run.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, your cram school's supposed to end soon...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I guess we have to say bye here.
Get home safe, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you for inviting me today...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It was nice to see you again...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Even after you get home, you probably won't be able to take your mind off things...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But we'll always be on your side.
So...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: All of us in N25... We'll always be waiting for you in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Mizuki...
What's going on? You asked us to meet sort of out of the blue.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Did you come up with a good idea for Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. Sorry, I know this is really sudden.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But there's something I need to tell you two...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I just saw Mafuyu and let her know that it's okay for her to run.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You told Mafuyu about all that...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah...
And I'm really sorry about going to talk to her without asking you guys first.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But I felt that I needed to tell her.
Before her spirit breaks...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, because I went ahead and did what I did, I thought I should tell you two what happened...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's okay for her to run...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I agree that Mafuyu should keep that option in mind considering her current state.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. As much as I want her to directly fight back, I guess she should have some contingencies ready if she doesn't think she can...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: If Mafuyu does decide to run, she'll always be welcome to stay at my house...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Same here. She won't be able to stay forever, but I'll try asking my mom about this...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There's no way of telling what's gonna happen to Mafuyu moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But I wanna do everything I can.
For her sake...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Looks like they know what to do now.
What is it with you and sneaking around like this...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? That sounds a bit odd considering how you're sitting next to me right now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You were also curious about what they were doing here, no?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's better than standing around and doing nothing.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And I want her to have as many options as possible right now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing how their solution is going to affect Mafuyu moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I was worried that Mafuyu's situation had gotten so bad that we wouldn't be able to do anything to help her...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But I got a chance to tell her how I feel. I managed to say, “It's okay to run.”)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But how she proceeds is up to her...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Still, if she does choose to run, that's gonna be on me...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'm honestly a little scared about her doing that, but I also wanna do everything I can to help her...)
